title.zh: 裸子植物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Gymnospermae to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开裸子植物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Araucariaceae time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的南洋杉类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Cycadophyta and Ginkgophyta through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较苏铁类与银杏类；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the Gymnospermae navigation envelope at the rounded 365 Ma Famennian seed sample to inspect the Hampshire Formation evidence that anchors early total-group seed plants.
description.zh: 在约 3.65 亿年前的法门期种子样本处打开裸子植物导航包络，检查汉普郡组证据如何锚定早期种子植物总群。

limitations: The rounded age is a Famennian Hampshire Formation sample envelope for total-group seed plants, not a crown-Gymnospermae age, global first appearance, direct ancestor sequence or complete distribution.

title.zh: 苏铁冠群年龄模型窗口

description.en: Open Cycadophyta at the rounded 330.4 Ma fossilized-birth–death median to inspect how fossil-integrated dating frames crown Cycadales alongside living cycads.
description.zh: 在约 3.304 亿年前的化石化出生–死亡模型中位数处打开苏铁类，检查化石整合定年如何结合现生苏铁界定苏铁目冠群。

limitations: The age is a model median with a 296.2–358.9 Ma 95% HPD, not a directly observed fossil FAD; the route does not establish a global cycad origin or synchronous living-species radiation.

title.zh: 苏铁科古近纪冠群模型

description.en: Open Cycadophyta around the rounded 69.3 Ma Cycadaceae model mean to inspect calibration- and tree-prior-dependent evidence for extant Cycadaceae.
description.zh: 在约 6930 万年前的苏铁科模型平均值附近打开苏铁类，检查依赖校准与树先验的现生苏铁科证据。

limitations: The 69.31 and 42.88 Ma means are alternative model-prior results for extant Cycadaceae, not fossil first appearances, an age for all cycads or a direct ancestor sequence.

title.zh: 桃花山组银杏木材窗口

description.en: Open Ginkgophyta across the rounded 153–165 Ma Tiaojishan interval to inspect PB22285, the diagnosed Ginkgoxylon liaoningense wood specimen from western Liaoning.
description.zh: 在约 1.53–1.65 亿年前的桃花山组区间打开银杏类，检查辽西标本 PB22285 及其鉴定的辽宁银杏木材。

limitations: The interval belongs to one dated wood specimen and its organ-taxon diagnosis; it does not establish the phylum FAD, an unbroken lineage, a particular co-occurring leaf species or direct ancestry of living Ginkgo.

description.en: Open Coniferophyta at the rounded 8.7 Ma Southern Hemisphere sampled-node median to inspect its modelled contrast with the 5.2 Ma Northern Hemisphere sample.
description.zh: 在约 870 万年前的南半球取样节点中位数处打开松柏类，检查其与约 520 万年前北半球取样的模型对比。

limitations: These are relative modelled ages from 489 sampled living conifer species and 16 fossil calibrations, not fossil range endpoints, a complete conifer history or proof of climatic causation.

title.zh: 霍利奥克南洋杉科苞鳞片窗口

description.en: Open Araucariaceae at the rounded 201.4 Ma Hettangian endpoint to inspect specimen J 1430 from the South Hadley Falls Member and its bract-scale anatomy.
description.zh: 在约 2.014 亿年前的赫塘期端点处打开南洋杉科，检查南哈德利瀑布段标本 J 1430 及其苞鳞片解剖。

limitations: The Hettangian endpoint is a named Massachusetts specimen anchor in a sample-to-living navigation anthology, not the family FAD, a Triassic absence claim, an exact crown origin or direct ancestry.
